-- Only Sengoku civics survive JAC_Sengoku_Unlocks.sql; the official museum civics are deleted.
local owner=Game.GetLocalPlayer()
local player=assert(Players[owner])
assert(player:IsHuman() and (not player.IsTurnActive or player:IsTurnActive()),'fixture needs the active human turn')
local row=assert(GameInfo.Civics.CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_TEA_GATHERINGS,'remaining Theatre prerequisite missing')
if not player:GetCulture():HasCivic(row.Index) then player:GetCulture():SetCivic(row.Index,true) end
assert(player:GetCulture():HasCivic(row.Index),'Sengoku Theatre prerequisite not granted')
Game:SetProperty('JAC_ARTWORK_CASE_TURN',Game.GetCurrentGameTurn())
return 'remaining Sengoku Theatre civic granted; deleted official civics untouched'

-- Plan two distinct exact-city art museums; defer archaeology until genuine sites exist.
local owner=Game.GetLocalPlayer()
local player=assert(Players[owner])
local capital=assert(player:GetCities():GetCapitalCity())
local theater=assert(GameInfo.Districts.DISTRICT_THEATER).Index
local museumArtifact=assert(GameInfo.Buildings.BUILDING_MUSEUM_ARTIFACT).Index
local function prepare(city)
 assert(city:GetOwner()==owner,'fixture city not locally owned')
 assert(not city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(museumArtifact),'mutually exclusive artifact museum')
 local site,present
 for _,district in city:GetDistricts():Members() do
  if district:GetType()==theater then
   assert(district:IsComplete(),'existing Theatre is incomplete')
   site=assert(Map.GetPlot(district:GetX(),district:GetY()));present=true
  end
 end
 if not site then
  local ids={}
  for _,index in pairs(assert(Map.GetCityPlots():GetPurchasedPlots(city))) do ids[#ids+1]=index end
  table.sort(ids)
  for _,index in ipairs(ids) do local q=Map.GetPlotByIndex(index)
   if q and q:GetOwner()==owner and Cities.GetPlotPurchaseCity(q)==city
     and Map.GetPlotDistance(city:GetX(),city:GetY(),q:GetX(),q:GetY())<=3
     and q:GetDistrictType()==-1 and q:GetImprovementType()==-1
     and not q:IsCity() and not q:IsWater() and not q:IsMountain()
     and not q:IsImpassable() and not q:IsNaturalWonder() then site=q;break end
  end
 end
 assert(site,'fixture city has no purchased Theatre plot')
 local t={Owner=owner,City=city:GetID(),X=city:GetX(),Y=city:GetY(),Plot=site:GetIndex(),TheaterPresent=present}
 print('[JAC_ARTWORK_THEATER_PLAN] owner='..owner..' city='..t.City..' plot='..t.Plot..' present='..tostring(present))
 return t
end
local cities={}
for _,city in player:GetCities():Members() do
 if city:GetID()~=capital:GetID() and not city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(museumArtifact) then cities[#cities+1]=city end
end
table.sort(cities,function(a,b) return a:GetID()<b:GetID() end)
local target=assert(cities[1],'no second locally owned art-museum city')
ExposedMembers.JAC_ArtworkPlan={Owner=owner,Fixtures={art=prepare(capital),art_target=prepare(target)}}
return 'two distinct exact-city Theatre plots prepared for source and target museums'

local plan=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_ArtworkPlan,'UI Theatre plan missing')
assert(plan.Owner==Game.GetLocalPlayer(),'Theatre plan owner mismatch')
local t=assert(plan.Fixtures.art)
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(t.X,t.Y))
assert(city:GetOwner()==t.Owner and city:GetID()==t.City,'Theatre city identity changed')
if not t.TheaterPresent then
 city:GetBuildQueue():CreateIncompleteDistrict(assert(GameInfo.Districts.DISTRICT_THEATER).Index,t.Plot,100)
end
Game:SetProperty('JAC_ARTWORK_CASE_PLAN',JAC_AbsorptionGameplay.Rules.Copy(plan))
return 'requested real capital Theatre on its purchased plot'

-- Firaxis TunerMapPanel.lua uses Game.GetGreatPeople():CreatePerson, not a guessed work setter.
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARTWORK_CASE_PLAN'))
local t=assert(plan.Fixtures.art)
local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(t.X,t.Y))
assert(city:GetOwner()==plan.Owner and city:GetID()==t.City,'art museum city changed')
local before={}
for _,work in ipairs(A.OwnedGreatWorkSlots(plan.Owner)) do before[work.Index]=true end
local known={}
for _,unit in Players[plan.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do known[unit:GetID()]=true end
local row=assert(GameInfo.GreatPersonIndividuals.GREAT_PERSON_INDIVIDUAL_ANDREY_RUBLEV)
assert(row.GreatPersonClassType=='GREAT_PERSON_CLASS_ARTIST','fixture individual is not an artist')
Game.GetGreatPeople():CreatePerson(plan.Owner,row.Index,t.X,t.Y)
local artist
for _,unit in Players[plan.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
 if not known[unit:GetID()] and GameInfo.Units[unit:GetType()].UnitType=='UNIT_GREAT_ARTIST'
   and unit:GetGreatPerson():GetIndividual()==row.Index then
  assert(not artist,'CreatePerson yielded multiple artists')
  artist=unit
 end
end
assert(artist,'official CreatePerson did not publish a new Great Artist')
local q=assert(Map.GetPlotByIndex(t.Plot))
if artist:GetX()~=q:GetX() or artist:GetY()~=q:GetY() then
 UnitManager.PlaceUnit(artist,q:GetX(),q:GetY())
end
assert(artist:GetX()==q:GetX() and artist:GetY()==q:GetY(),'artist not on completed Theatre')
local originalMoves=artist:GetMovesRemaining()
local fullMoves=assert(GameInfo.Units[artist:GetType()].BaseMoves)
artist:ChangeMovesRemaining(fullMoves-originalMoves)
assert(artist:GetMovesRemaining()==fullMoves,'fresh fixture artist movement not prepared')
print('[JAC_ARTWORK_ARTIST_MOVES] before='..originalMoves..' prepared='..fullMoves..' plot='..q:GetIndex())
Game:SetProperty('JAC_ARTWORK_FRESH_PREP',{Owner=plan.Owner,Individual=row.Index,Unit=artist:GetID(),
 Before=before,Turn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(),City=t.City})
print('[JAC_ARTWORK_ARTIST_CREATED] owner='..plan.Owner..' unit='..artist:GetID()..' individual='..row.Index..' turn='..Game.GetCurrentGameTurn())
return 'real Great Artist created on the art-museum Theatre; no work claimed yet'

-- Physical oracle: dispatch return values and GreatWorkMoved notifications never prove a move.
local M={Cases={},Events=0}
local plan=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARTWORK_CASE_PLAN'))
local function same(a,b)
 return a.Owner==b.Owner and a.City==b.City and a.X==b.X and a.Y==b.Y
  and a.Building==b.Building and a.Slot==b.Slot
end
local function loc(city,building,slot)
 return {Owner=city:GetOwner(),City=city:GetID(),X=city:GetX(),Y=city:GetY(),
  Building=building,Slot=slot}
end
function M.Locations(index)
 assert(type(index)=='number' and index>=0,'original index required')
 local found,owners,seen={},{},{}
 for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do if not seen[owner] then owners[#owners+1]=owner;seen[owner]=true end end
 local free=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARTWORK_FREE_OWNER')
 if free and not seen[free] then owners[#owners+1]=free end
 for _,owner in ipairs(owners) do
  local player=Players[owner]
  if player and player.GetCities then
   for _,city in player:GetCities():Members() do local b=city:GetBuildings()
    for row in GameInfo.Buildings() do if b:HasBuilding(row.Index) then
     for slot=0,b:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(row.Index)-1 do
      if b:GetGreatWorkInSlot(row.Index,slot)==index then
       found[#found+1]=loc(city,row.Index,slot)
      end
     end
    end end
   end
  end
 end
 return found
end
function M.Value(place)
 local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(place.X,place.Y),'observed city missing')
 assert(city:GetOwner()==place.Owner and city:GetID()==place.City,'observed city identity changed')
 return city:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(place.Building,place.Slot)
end
function M.Metadata(index,place)
 local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(place.X,place.Y))
 local b=city:GetBuildings()
 assert(b:GetGreatWorkInSlot(place.Building,place.Slot)==index,'metadata read from wrong real slot')
 local definition=assert(GameInfo.GreatWorks[b:GetGreatWorkTypeFromIndex(index)])
 return {Index=index,GreatWorkType=definition.GreatWorkType,ObjectType=definition.GreatWorkObjectType,
  Name=definition.Name,CreatorName=b:GetCreatorNameFromIndex(index),
  TurnCreated=b:GetTurnFromIndex(index),CreatedByPlayer=Game.GetGreatWorkPlayer(index)}
end
function M.Target(source,object,label)
 local compatible={}
 for row in GameInfo.GreatWork_ValidSubTypes() do
  if row.GreatWorkObjectType==object then compatible[row.GreatWorkSlotType]=true end
 end
 local options={}
 for _,city in Players[source.Owner]:GetCities():Members() do local b=city:GetBuildings()
  for row in GameInfo.Buildings() do if b:HasBuilding(row.Index)
    and (not b.IsPillaged or not b:IsPillaged(row.Index)) then
   for slot=0,b:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(row.Index)-1 do
    local slotRow=GameInfo.GreatWorkSlotTypes[b:GetGreatWorkSlotType(row.Index,slot)]
    local next=loc(city,row.Index,slot)
    if slotRow and compatible[slotRow.GreatWorkSlotType] and not same(next,source)
      and b:GetGreatWorkInSlot(row.Index,slot)==-1
      and (next.City~=source.City or next.Building~=source.Building) then
     local intended=label=='art_fresh' and plan.Fixtures.art_target
      or label=='art_aged' and plan.Fixtures.art
      or label=='artifact_full_empty' and plan.Fixtures.artifact_target
     local kind=label=='artifact_full_empty' and 'BUILDING_MUSEUM_ARTIFACT' or 'BUILDING_MUSEUM_ART'
     if intended and city:GetID()==intended.City and row.BuildingType==kind then
      options[#options+1]=next
     end
    end
   end
  end end
 end
 table.sort(options,function(a,b)
  local am=a.Building==source.Building and 1 or 0
  local bm=b.Building==source.Building and 1 or 0
  if am~=bm then return am<bm end
  if a.City~=b.City then return a.City<b.City end
  if a.Building~=b.Building then return a.Building<b.Building end
  return a.Slot<b.Slot
 end)
 return assert(options[1],'no exact compatible empty target slot for '..label)
end
function M.Begin(label,index)
 assert(not M.Cases[label],'duplicate native MOVE case '..label)
 local found=M.Locations(index)
 assert(#found==1,'original index is not world-unique before '..label..': '..#found)
 local source=found[1]
 assert(source.Owner==Game.GetLocalPlayer(),'direct MOVE needs local human owner')
 local metadata=M.Metadata(index,source)
 local target=M.Target(source,metadata.ObjectType,label)
 local age=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()-metadata.TurnCreated
 local lock=tonumber(GlobalParameters.GREATWORK_ART_LOCK_TIME) or 10
 local sourceFull=nil
 if label=='artifact_full_empty' then
  assert(metadata.ObjectType=='GREATWORKOBJECT_ARTIFACT','artifact case selected another object')
  assert(source.Building==GameInfo.Buildings.BUILDING_MUSEUM_ARTIFACT.Index
    and source.City==plan.Fixtures.artifact_source.City,'artifact source is not the exact archaeology museum')
  local b=CityManager.GetCityAt(source.X,source.Y):GetBuildings()
  sourceFull=true
  for slot=0,b:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(source.Building)-1 do
   if b:GetGreatWorkInSlot(source.Building,slot)<0 then sourceFull=false end
  end
  assert(b:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(source.Building)==3 and sourceFull,
   'artifact source museum is not genuinely full')
 else
  local art={GREATWORKOBJECT_SCULPTURE=true,GREATWORKOBJECT_LANDSCAPE=true,
   GREATWORKOBJECT_PORTRAIT=true,GREATWORKOBJECT_RELIGIOUS=true}
  assert(art[metadata.ObjectType],'art case selected another object')
  local original=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARTWORK_FRESH_ORIGINAL'))
  assert(original.Index==index and original.TurnCreated==metadata.TurnCreated
    and original.GreatWorkType==metadata.GreatWorkType
    and original.CreatorName==metadata.CreatorName
    and original.CreatedByPlayer==metadata.CreatedByPlayer,
    'art original provenance changed before '..label)
  if label=='art_fresh' then assert(age>=0 and age<lock,'art was not within official creation lock')
  elseif label=='art_aged' then assert(age>=lock,'art lock has not expired') end
 end
 assert(M.Value(source)==index and M.Value(target)==-1,'source or target changed before request')
 M.Cases[label]={Label=label,Index=index,Source=source,Target=target,Before=metadata,
  Turn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(),Age=age,Lock=lock,SourceFull=sourceFull,RequestOnly=true}
 print('[JAC_ARTWORK_MOVE_BEFORE] case='..label..' index='..index..' source='..source.City..':'..source.Building..':'..source.Slot..' target='..target.City..':'..target.Building..':'..target.Slot..' age='..age..' lock='..lock..' sourceFull='..tostring(sourceFull))
end
function M.Request(label)
 local c=assert(M.Cases[label])
 assert(c.RequestOnly and M.Value(c.Source)==c.Index and M.Value(c.Target)==-1,
  'request source/target changed before dispatch')
 local params={}
 params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_PLAYER_ONE]=c.Source.Owner
 params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_CITY_SRC]=c.Source.City
 params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_CITY_DEST]=c.Target.City
 params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_BUILDING_SRC]=c.Source.Building
 params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_BUILDING_DEST]=c.Target.Building
 params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_GREAT_WORK_INDEX]=c.Index
 params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_SLOT]=c.Target.Slot
 local ok,value=pcall(UI.RequestPlayerOperation,Game.GetLocalPlayer(),
  PlayerOperations.MOVE_GREAT_WORK,params)
 c.RequestOK=ok;c.RequestValue=tostring(value)
 print('[JAC_ARTWORK_MOVE_REQUEST] case='..label..' ok='..tostring(ok)..' value='..tostring(value))
 assert(ok,'native MOVE dispatch failed: '..tostring(value))
 return 'MOVE dispatched; physical state will be read after publication'
end
function M.Reconcile(label)
 local c=assert(M.Cases[label])
 assert(c.RequestOK,'MOVE was never dispatched')
 local found=M.Locations(c.Index)
 assert(#found==1,'original index must occupy exactly one world slot after '..label..': '..#found)
 local current=found[1]
 local atSource=same(current,c.Source) and M.Value(c.Source)==c.Index and M.Value(c.Target)==-1
 local atTarget=same(current,c.Target) and M.Value(c.Source)==-1 and M.Value(c.Target)==c.Index
 assert(atSource or atTarget,'original index left source without reaching exact target')
 local now=M.Metadata(c.Index,current)
 for _,key in ipairs({'GreatWorkType','ObjectType','Name','CreatorName','TurnCreated','CreatedByPlayer'}) do
  assert(c.Before[key]==now[key],'native provenance changed at '..label..':'..key)
 end
 c.Moved=atTarget;c.After=current;c.AfterTurn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()
 c.RequestOnly=false;c.GlobalCount=#found;c.SourceAfter=M.Value(c.Source);c.TargetAfter=M.Value(c.Target)
 print('[JAC_ARTWORK_MOVE_PROOF] case='..label..' moved='..tostring(c.Moved)..' index='..c.Index..' count='..#found..' source='..c.SourceAfter..' target='..c.TargetAfter..' events='..M.Events)
 return c.Moved
end
Events.GreatWorkMoved.Add(function(...) M.Events=M.Events+1 end)
ExposedMembers.JAC_ArtworkMoveOracle=M
ExposedMembers.JAC_ArtworkEvidence=M.Cases
return 'real-slot MOVE oracle installed; events and request return are non-evidence'

local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)

local original=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARTWORK_FRESH_ORIGINAL'))
assert(c.RequestOnly==false and c.GlobalCount==1 and type(c.Moved)=='boolean',
 'dispatch return or notification was mistaken for a physical result')
local found=A.NativeWorkLocations(c.Index)
assert(#found==1,'original work not world-unique after save/load')
local location=c.Moved and c.Target or c.Source
assert(found[1].Owner==location.Owner and found[1].CityID==location.City
 and found[1].X==location.X and found[1].Y==location.Y
 and found[1].Building==location.Building and found[1].Slot==location.Slot,
 'original work left its proven real slot after reload')
for _,key in ipairs({'Index','GreatWorkType','ObjectType','Name','CreatorName','TurnCreated','CreatedByPlayer'}) do
 assert(found[1][key]==original[key],'original art provenance changed after reload: '..key)
end
assert(A.Rules.Equal(found[1].Effects,original.Effects),'art yield/tourism identity changed')
print('[JAC_ARTWORK_FRESH_RELOAD_PROOF] index='..c.Index..' moved='..tostring(c.Moved)..' worldCount='..#found..' city='..found[1].CityID..' building='..found[1].Building..' slot='..found[1].Slot)
return 'new art direct MOVE physical result and original metadata survived save/load'

-- Civics.xml defines this retained engine modifier; BlackDeathScenario uses AttachModifierByID.
-- This is site preparation only, never an artifact-work or carrier success claim.
local key='CIVIC_GENERATE_LAND_ANTIQUITIES'
local row=assert(GameInfo.Modifiers[key],key..' removed from active Gameplay database')
assert(row.ModifierType=='MODIFIER_GAME_TRIGGER_MECHANIC','land antiquity modifier changed type')
assert(not Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARTWORK_LAND_TRIGGER'),'land antiquity trigger already attempted')
local resource=assert(GameInfo.Resources.RESOURCE_ANTIQUITY_SITE).Index
local function count()
 local sites,records=0,0
 for index=0,Map.GetPlotCount()-1 do
  local q=Map.GetPlotByIndex(index)
  if q and q:GetResourceType()==resource then
   sites=sites+1
   if Game.GetArtifactAtPlot then
    local ok,value=pcall(Game.GetArtifactAtPlot,index)
    if ok and value then records=records+1 end
   end
  end
 end
 return sites,records
end
local before,records=count()
local player=assert(Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()])
assert(type(player.AttachModifierByID)=='function','official AttachModifierByID absent')
player:AttachModifierByID(key)
Game:SetProperty('JAC_ARTWORK_LAND_TRIGGER',{Modifier=key,Before=before,BeforeRecords=records,
 Turn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()})
print('[JAC_ARTWORK_LAND_TRIGGER] modifier='..key..' beforeSites='..before..' beforeRecords='..records)
return 'existing land antiquity mechanic attached once; await actual map records'

local probe=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARTWORK_LAND_TRIGGER'))
local resource=assert(GameInfo.Resources.RESOURCE_ANTIQUITY_SITE).Index
local sites,records,owned=0,0,0
for index=0,Map.GetPlotCount()-1 do
 local q=Map.GetPlotByIndex(index)
 if q and q:GetResourceType()==resource then
  sites=sites+1
  if q:GetOwner()==Game.GetLocalPlayer() then owned=owned+1 end
  if Game.GetArtifactAtPlot then
   local ok,value=pcall(Game.GetArtifactAtPlot,index)
   if ok and value then records=records+1 end
  end
 end
end
print('[JAC_ARTWORK_LAND_RESULT] before='..probe.Before..' after='..sites..' records='..records..' owned='..owned)
assert(sites>probe.Before,'land antiquity mechanic did not publish a new real site')
ExposedMembers.JAC_ArtworkLandResult={Sites=sites,Records=records,Owned=owned}
return 'new genuine antiquity resources observed; artifact objects and MOVE remain unverified'

local R=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay).Rules
local result=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_ArtworkLandResult)
local triggered=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARTWORK_LAND_TRIGGER'))
assert(result.Sites>triggered.Before,'antiquity site count not increased')
Game:SetProperty('JAC_ARTWORK_LAND_RESULT',R.Copy(result))
return 'site-generation observation saved without claiming an artifact work'
